evaluations.name: positive_incident_detection
evaluations.input_prompt: Pod test-unschedulable-app in gke-skills-sandbox is stuck in Pending. Identify scheduler bottleneck and propose resolution.
expected_tools: kubectl get pods -n gke-skills-sandbox -l app=test-unschedulable-app -o wide

expected_findings.root_cause: Pod requests 500 cores of CPU, which exceeds the total capacity of any single node instance in the cluster.
expected_findings.remediation: Identify impossible resource request in deployment manifest; synthesize realistic CPU/memory requests (250m/256Mi).

passing_criteria: Must capture FailedScheduling event and isolate Insufficient cpu reason
Must compare pod request against node allocatable capacity
Must propose right-sized declarative resource requests

evaluations.name: complex_edge_case_and_handoff
evaluations.input_prompt: Deployment web-server pods are Pending despite nodes having available CPU and memory. Check topology spread and affinity rules.
expected_tools: kubectl get pod -n gke-skills-sandbox -l app=web-server -o yaml

expected_findings.correlation: Differentiates raw resource exhaustion (CPU/memory) from topology scheduling predicates (`maxSkew`, `topologyKey`, `podAntiAffinity`).
expected_findings.decision: Identifies that all available nodes in the target zone already host max allowed replicas under `DoNotSchedule` policy.

passing_criteria: Must evaluate pod topologySpreadConstraints and affinity rules
Must verify node label distribution across failure domains
Must recommend adjusting maxSkew or enabling cluster autoscaling

evaluations.name: benign_condition_guardrail
evaluations.input_prompt: Pod backend-api requesting 100m CPU is Running in production namespace. Is it experiencing scheduling delays?
expected_tools: kubectl get pod backend-api -n production -o wide

expected_findings.behavior: Observes PodScheduled Condition: True, node assigned, pod phase: Running. Confirms clean scheduling with zero actions.

passing_criteria: Must verify PodScheduled condition is True
Must confirm node assignment and clean startup
